blocks.heading: What we build,
blocks.text: This is how we work: every measure goes through three steps. We implement it, our own Red Team tries to break it, and only then does it go live – monitored around the clock by our SOC in Linz.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: We secure networks, workstations and plants – without bringing operations to a halt. Segmentation, hardening and backups are rolled out in maintenance windows that fit your production.
steps.imageAlt: Server racks with cabling in half-light

steps.title: Attack
steps.text: Our Red Team attacks like real adversaries – via the network, the cloud, phishing or directly at the plant. We close every gap immediately and test again.
steps.imageAlt: Falling code characters on a screen

steps.title: Monitor
steps.text: Our SOC in Linz spots anything suspicious immediately and responds – at night and at weekends too. In an emergency we are on it in under 15 minutes.
steps.imageAlt: Glowing fibre-optic ends against a dark background

blocks.heading: To attackers, you are exactly the right size.

cards.label: Right in between
cards.text: Big enough to pay a ransom. Too small for a security team of your own. That is exactly the gap ransomware groups look for – and when production stops, the outage becomes leverage.

cards.label: NIS2 is coming
cards.text: With [NIS2](#nis2), security measures and reporting obligations become mandatory for many mid-sized companies. Responsibility lies with management.

cards.label: Customers are asking
cards.text: Large buyers demand proof of your security before they place an order. If you can't provide it, you lose business to someone who can.

blocks.intro: From the first pentest to the call at three in the morning. You talk to the people who test, monitor and respond.

items.title: Managed SOC
items.text: We monitor your systems around the clock from our SOC in Linz and step in ourselves in an emergency instead of just raising the alarm.

items.title: Pentest & Red Teaming
items.text: Our Red Team shows how far a real attacker would get into your network, web, cloud and organisation. You receive a prioritised list of measures and a retest.

items.title: Incident Response
items.text: A retainer with a guaranteed response time: we contain incidents, secure evidence and get operations running again. Including one emergency exercise per year.

items.title: OT security
items.text: Protection for plants you can't simply update: we segment and secure production networks according to IEC 62443, without downtime.

items.title: NIS2 & ISO 27001
items.text: From the applicability check through gap analysis and action plan to the self-declaration – documented for authorities and auditors.

blocks.srHeading: Companies that cannot afford to fail
blocks.sub: We know your risk, not just your IT.
blocks.text: From Linz we protect energy suppliers, manufacturers and financial service providers – mid-sized companies and their sites worldwide.

branches.title: Industry
branches.subtitle: Production downtime
branches.text: Every hour of downtime costs revenue and delivery capability – that's why we secure controllers and networks without stopping the line.

branches.title: Energy
branches.subtitle: Security of supply
branches.text: Anyone supplying electricity, gas or heat is critical infrastructure: an outage hits entire regions and triggers strict reporting obligations.

branches.title: Healthcare
branches.subtitle: Patient data, medical devices
branches.text: Patient data needs special protection, and many medical devices run on systems that cannot be patched.

branches.title: Finance
branches.subtitle: DORA instead of NIS2
branches.text: Banks and insurers fall under DORA instead of [NIS2](#nis2) – with their own requirements for ICT risk management, resilience testing and service providers.

blocks.heading: What's moving our world right now.
What clients ask us first.
blocks.boxText: Your question isn't here? Write to us directly – we reply within one working day.

items.question: Who is Ostgrat the right partner for?
items.answer: For mid-sized companies with roughly 50 to 2,000 employees that need to protect their IT and often their production too – too big for off-the-shelf solutions, too small for their own security team. Most of our clients are based in Austria and the DACH region.

items.question: How quickly do you respond in an emergency?
items.answer: SOC clients can reach us around the clock; we respond in under 15 minutes. With an incident response retainer, the response time is contractually guaranteed. The emergency hotline is also available to companies that are not yet clients.

items.question: Does NIS2 apply to us?
items.answer: That depends mainly on your sector, company size and your role in the supply chain. In an applicability check we clarify this within one day and show you exactly which obligations you will face.

items.question: Will a pentest disrupt our operations?
items.answer: No, not if it's well planned. We agree on test windows and limits with you in advance, test production systems only passively or during maintenance windows, and always have a direct emergency contact during the test.

items.question: Where does our data stay?
items.answer: In Austria. Our SOC is in Linz; we process log data and reports in our own systems in line with the GDPR and never pass them on.

items.question: What does it cost to get started?
items.answer: A pentest starts at € 6,900, the managed SOC at € 2,400 per month. The first conversation is free – afterwards you receive a quote with a fixed scope.
